Callout.Name: Cyclist Collision
Callout.Message: Cyclist struck by a car, driver on scene.
Callout.Advisory: Casualty in the road, driver cooperating, lane blocked.
Callout.Patient: My shoulder. I went over the bonnet.

Lines.Approach: Cyclist down and the driver is with him, and he is not moving his arm.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
